content:
A logo has a harder job than most people expect. The same mark has to work on a glass signboard, as a tiny WhatsApp profile picture, as a browser favicon, embroidered on a staff uniform, printed in one colour on a GST invoice and stamped on packaging. A logo that looks great in a presentation but turns into a blur at 32 pixels is not finished. At TopWebExpert we design logos and brand identities for startups and established businesses across Gurugram, and we design with those real uses in mind from the first sketch.

Where Your Logo Will Actually Live

Before we draw anything, we list every place the logo needs to appear. For a D2C brand that means the Instagram grid, Amazon or Flipkart listings, courier boxes and a Shopify favicon. For a clinic on Golf Course Road it means a lit sign, appointment slips, doctor coats and Google Maps. For a real estate developer launching along Dwarka Expressway it means hoardings seen from a moving car, site banners and brochures. For a coaching institute it means student ID cards, YouTube thumbnails and a banner outside a busy market. Each context sets rules on shape, detail and colour, and we test against them.

Logo Only, or a Full Brand Identity?

Not every business needs the full package. We offer two levels of work:

  • Logo design: the primary logo, a stacked or horizontal version, an icon mark, colour and single-colour versions, and a one-page usage sheet. Right for a new business that needs to start trading.
  • Brand identity: everything above plus a colour palette with print and screen values, typography, patterns or graphic elements, business cards, letterhead, email signature, social media templates and a brand guidelines document. Right for a business that will have several people or agencies producing material.

How the Work Unfolds

  1. Week 1: Brand workshop. A session at our Sohna Road office in Sector 49 or on a video call. We cover who your customers are, what you want to be known for, competitors you want to stand apart from, and words that describe your brand. You get a written creative brief to approve.
  2. Week 2: Concepts. We explore many directions on paper and in Adobe Illustrator, then present two to three distinct concepts shown in real mock-ups, not on a white background.
  3. Weeks 3–4: Refinement. You pick one direction and we refine it over agreed revision rounds: proportions, spacing, colour and type.
  4. Weeks 4–6: Identity system and handover. For brand identity projects, we build the supporting elements and guidelines, then deliver the full file pack.

A logo-only project usually takes three to four weeks. A full brand identity usually takes five to six, depending on how quickly feedback comes back.

The Final File Pack

You receive every version in the formats your printers, developers and marketing team will ask for:

  • AI (Illustrator source)
  • SVG
  • EPS
  • PDF (print-ready)
  • PNG with transparent background
  • JPG
  • Favicon and app icon sizes
  • Social media profile sizes
  • CMYK, RGB, HEX and Pantone references

Checking the Mark Before You Commit

A logo you cannot protect is a risk. Before finalising, we run a basic search on the IP India public trademark search and look at competitors in your category to reduce the chance of a close conflict. This is a preliminary check, not legal advice, and we recommend that you file the trademark through a qualified trademark attorney once the logo is final. We also check that the fonts used are licensed for commercial use and that no stock elements are included.

Who Owns the Logo

Under Indian copyright law, the designer of a commissioned artwork can remain the first owner of copyright unless rights are assigned, and the assignment must be in writing. So we do not leave it to assumption: once the project is paid for, we give you a signed copyright assignment for the final logo and identity artwork, along with the editable source files. Unused concepts stay with us and are not sold to anyone else as-is.

How We Check Quality

  • The logo is tested at very small sizes, from a favicon to a WhatsApp display picture.
  • It is checked in single-colour black and white for stamps, invoices and embroidery.
  • It is placed on light, dark and photographic backgrounds.
  • Hindi or bilingual versions are checked with native readers when the brand uses Devanagari.
  • Print proofs are reviewed before any large print run.

What We Ask You to Prepare

Bring your final business name and tagline if you have one, a short list of competitors, examples of brands you like and dislike (from any industry), and details of where the logo will be used first. Most importantly, decide who has the final say. Logos designed by committee tend to end up safe and forgettable.

Common Mistakes With Logos

  • Putting too much detail or a tagline inside the mark so it cannot shrink.
  • Choosing colours that only work on screen and look dull when printed.
  • Using a free template or stock icon that competitors can also use.
  • Receiving only a JPG, then paying again when a printer asks for a vector file.
  • Skipping a trademark check and having to rebrand after launch.

When We Are Not the Right Choice

If you need a logo by tomorrow or want dozens of options to pick from at the lowest possible cost, a template marketplace will suit you better. We are also not a fit if the business name is still undecided; naming should come first, because the logo depends on it.

Logo Design FAQs

How many concepts and revisions do we get?

We present two to three developed concepts and include a fixed number of revision rounds on the chosen one. The exact number is written into your quote so there are no surprises.

What decides the cost of a logo?

Cost depends on whether you need a logo only or a full identity, how many applications we design, whether bilingual versions are needed, and the research involved. After a free consultation we give you a fixed quote.

Can you refresh our existing logo instead of starting again?

Yes. If your current logo has recognition, a careful refresh that keeps its core shape and colour is often wiser than a full change.

Will you design our signboard and packaging too?

We design the artwork for signage, stationery and packaging and can coordinate with your printer or fabricator to make sure the files are used correctly.

We are in Manesar, not central Gurugram. Can we still work with you?

Of course. Many clients join the workshop by video, and for businesses anywhere in Gurgaon or Manesar a visit to our office is a short drive.
